criteria.source: Tastekin, de Haan Vicente et al. 2026, Cell 189:5527-5551 (valence assignments; their map is unsigned)
criteria.measure: input-normalised signed path products, cumulative over hops 1..5
criteria.S1: proboscis (MN9+MN6): mean cumulative signed of LB3a-c > 0 AND mean of LB1a-d below it
criteria.S2: at least 5 of LB3a-c, LB1a-d have cumulative signed influence on MN9 with sign matching valence
criteria.S3: LB2 has the largest |cumulative signed| on MN11D+MN11V among labellar groups
